description: List the Chat channels in a Workspace (ClickUp Chat v3), with each channel's id, name, type and visibility. Use to discover a `channel_id` before reading or sending messages. Paginated via `cursor`/`limit`.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (the `next_cursor` returned by a previous call). Omit for the first page.

include_hidden.description: If true, also include hidden channels.

is_follower.description: If true, only return channels the current user follows.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return in this page.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: list_chat_channels
